paragraphs: Since December 2024 I've been building an AI knowledge platform for a European industrial client at a German software company. Most of my week goes into multi-tenant RAG pipelines on Weaviate and LangGraph multi-agent workflows, plus the Angular, Vue.js and NestJS app they live in.

Before that I freelanced for two years on the MERN stack, shipping e-commerce platforms and event-driven microservices on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes and RabbitMQ. I still own features end to end, from the database schema to the Kubernetes deploy.
